GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS AND
  EFFICIENCY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, JULY 22, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 2:40 PM

Kristina Duggan, Chair
Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, Vice Chair
Mary Zendejas, Member

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-55890  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Government Operations and
  Efficiency Committee meeting of Tuesday, April 15, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-55891  Recommendation to approve and refer back to City Council for consideration and
  approval, the naming of the Junior Lifeguard Facility at the Claremont Small Boat
  Launch Ramp the “Pat Flynn and Dick Miller Junior Lifeguard Facility”, in
  accordance with City of Long Beach Administrative Regulation AR 8-7 facility
  naming process and the support of the Marine Advisory Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-55892  Recommendation to request Government Operations and Efficiency Committee
  feedback and identify recommendations for City Council meeting efficiency and
  public participation including additional research, staff engagement, and further
  exploration to be brought back to the Committee for potential advancement to the
  full Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Government Operations and Efficiency Committee on non-agenda items.
 Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Karen Baldwin, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
